tools.name: vine-spawn-with-trumpet-flowers-20261019.json
tools.description: Grow vines with leaves, buds and five-lobed trumpet flowers over the objects you select in Unity, in up to 10 flower colours picked as squares from a palette. Unity Unicorn's page sends the colours to the chosen world's open editor through a job file in Downloads.
tools.command_template: Copy scripts/unity-editor/vine-spawn-with-trumpet-flowers-20261019.cs into the world's Assets/UnityUnicorn/Editor/, then open Tools > Unity Unicorn > vine-spawn-with-trumpet-flowers (or press Open in Unity in the page's vine panel)
requirements: Unity 2022.3 (the world's project). The tool writes its own Unity Stable/Vine Bloom shader the first time.
The world open in Unity with this file installed, for jobs from the page; the job file is saved to Downloads.
limitations: A web page cannot start Unity or write into a project: the page saves a job file, and the open editor picks it up within 2 seconds.
Vines grow over meshes (no colliders needed); one mesh per selected object, up to 150,000 triangles per Grow.
